GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG383.7 (3 Dec 45) CIS
(SCAPIN-384)
3 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Lt. Col. Yoshitada Nagatoma.
1. Subject name, Lt Col Yoshitada Nagatoma, appearing in Memorandum for Imperial Japanese Government, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file No. AG 383.7 (20 November 45) CIS, dated 20 November 1945, Subject: “Apprehension of Col Aoshitada Nagatjua,” will be corrected to read Lt Col Yoshitada Nagatoma.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend Lt Col Yoshitada Nagatoma and deliver him to the authorities of Omori Prison Camp for incarceration.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
